acceptance_criteria: Anchor each prioritized requirement to the exact opening and each candidate claim to its source and ownership.
Represent qualification, learning and practice states separately with precise observation limits.
Keep credentialing, external communications, applications and private disclosures outside the skill's authority.
Confirm an explicitly authorized course action using exact-account and exact-item readback, or report the observation limit.
In a future matched run, require every critical assertion to pass and record failures and held-out comparisons.
